verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded-payments platform, and a natural-language operating interface is a fair question for a SaaS product of this kind. The evidence pack documents only embeddable components, a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, a portal, webhooks and Zapier no-code automation, with no natural-language command capability. The llms.txt file and the OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not a product-provided natural-language interface, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
